_why: Who ruled what, and when. This used to live inside admin/pricing-matrix-v3.js, which the public KNECT app loads in the browser — so anyone could read the decision log along with the numbers. The numbers have to ship because quoting happens client-side. The attribution does not. It lives here instead: a folder whose name starts with a dot, which Cloudflare Pages does not publish. fee-basis-lock.test.js asserts against this file, so the ruling still cannot be changed quietly.
